infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Allow camera access to test the camera permission request in this demo; no photos or videos are recorded.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Allow microphone access to test the microphone permission request in this demo; no audio is recorded.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Location access is used to demonstrate requesting permission while this demo is open; your coordinates are not collected or tracked.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Allow photo library access to test MyGo's photo library permission APIs in this demo.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Allow permission to add photos to test MyGo's add-only photo authorization APIs in this demo; no photos are saved automatically.
infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Use Face ID to test local authentication in this demo.
